The software product **Semrush outline builder** (also referred to as the Content Outline Builder) hosted on **semrush.com** is directly provided by **Semrush, Inc.**.

### Supporting Evidence
According to the official **Semrush Terms of Service** and **Website Terms of Use** governing the platform and tools on `semrush.com`:
* *"The Services are provided by Semrush, Inc., a Delaware corporation, with entity number 4164033."*
* The Website Terms of Use apply to *"the Semrush Website, as defined in the Semrush Terms of Service... and all associated sites linked to the Website by Semrush Inc, a Delaware corporation with its principal place of business at 800 Boylston Street, Suite 2475, Boston, MA 02199, USA..."*
